reviews.title: Rx 6800 Kept resetting my pc
reviews.comment: Shipping was quick. Installed it immediately and immediately had issues. My pc would randomly reset. I could never load into Warzone without pc resetting. I was told by Respec (the seller) that my 750w gpu wasn’t enough. So I purchased a 1000w gold, Same issue. Requested a replacement through Amazon. After waiting 4 days they never shipped it. Put my 3050 back in pc works fine again. Based on my experience I don’t recommend.
reviews.author: Vaurice

reviews.title: Well... Its AMD
reviews.comment: Does it work? Yes.. Does it work as advertised? Yes... Would I suggest you get one?  No.. I used to be an AMD superfan..  I had a bad time with nVidia just bad luck... That was years ago..  I went to AMD for years. Recently I replaced a 2070 with another brand of this card.. the AMD arrived dead.. I refunded and bought this one.  and I am simply not impressed... It has a lot of whine..  I have had freezes and odd performance issuces in games that the 2070 didnt even break a sweat with... while.. in other games it drastically out performed the 2070. Ultimately, I am just not pleased with the overall card.. I hesitate to say I will go back to nVidia.. But my journey into AMD again, has not been without pain.
reviews.author: Nerd

reviews.title: Best Value
reviews.comment: I had no issues with this card, even being as an amazon renewed product. Looks brand new; I had no problem placing it into my computer and running games in 4k 144fps. A very high end GPU at a huge discount.
reviews.author: Sean

reviews.title: Great card, but not worth 420 dollars for a refurbished card
reviews.comment: If it was brand new i can see 420, but this is a refurbished card. Doesn’t matter how good of a condition the card is in, its refurbished
